original_metadata.title: Conformally perturbed ordinary and opposite-algebra twisted spectral triples for ergodic positive-dimensional compact Lie actions with a self-adjoint C1 factor
original_metadata.author: Farzad Fathizadeh; Olivier Gabriel
original_metadata.source_title: On the Chern-Gauss-Bonnet Theorem and Conformally Twisted Spectral Triples for C*-Dynamical Systems
original_metadata.difficulty_reason: The construction must control two mutually conjugated differential operators on a shared dense core and prove uniform relative bounds through a conformal deformation. It also preserves weak-Schatten summability using the ergodic representation multiplicity bound and a resolvent factorization, while an opposite-algebra twist cancels the unbounded derivative part of the right commutator. These operator-domain and noncommutative geometric obligations exceed an ordinary compact-resolvent or bounded-commutator exercise.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete4.1 spectral/twisted-spectral construction and all essential analytic3.2-3.8 support read. Peter-Weyl finite-component diagonalization gives essential self-adjointness at u=0; orthogonality of conformally transformed exact/coexact image closures controls d_u and d_u*, and the six-term uniform relative-bound estimate propagates a common core/domain by Kato-Rellich. The ergodic multiplicity bound compares unperturbed eigenvalues with the group Hodge operator, while the resolvent factorization preserves the weak-Schatten n+ ideal along u. Explicit left commutator and right twisted-commutator computations cancel all unbounded derivative terms, and domain preservation/parity are verified. Standard Peter-Weyl, multiplicity theorem, Kato-Rellich and compact-Lie-group Weyl summability are cited background. Standing self-adjointness h=h* from the definition of K_u is retained, although the final theorem abbreviates it as h in A1. No Euler characteristic or neighboring Hodge consequence is separately counted.

original_metadata.statement_scope: The positive-dimensional case n=dim G>=1 of author4.1. A unital C*-algebra with strongly continuous ergodic compact Lie group G action and unique invariant trace; h=h* in the action-C1 algebra, u in[0,1]. On GNS(A,phi0) tensor exterior(g*), K_u right-multiplies degree-k coefficients by exp((n/2-k)hu), D_u=K_u dK_-u+K_-u d*K_u has its unique self-adjoint extension from the common C1-form core. The left ordinary and right opposite-algebra beta-twisted triples (beta(a)=exp(hu)a exp(-hu)) are even and n+-summable, with source-defined dense bounded-commutator algebra. No non-self-adjoint factor or claim at n=0 is selected.
original_metadata.editorial_warning: Retain the standing h=h* hypothesis in the preceding definition of K_u; the final theorem only abbreviates h in A1. The selected scope is n>=1, where the weak-Schatten n+ ideal is defined.
